meta.title: Dropper | Just drop a file, and leave the rest to us
meta.desc: Dropper is a series of small tools where you just drop a file and the work gets done. The first one auto-adds event dates to Google Calendar. Works for any sport or situation.
hero.sub: Just drop a file, and leave the rest to us
hero.catchMain:
Drop a file.
We'll take it from there.
hero.catchClose: More tools are on the way.
tools.label: Series
tools.title: The Dropper series
tools.desc: Tools you use simply by dropping in a file. Pick the one that fits what you want to do and start right away.
tool1.name: Calendar Dropper
tool1.desc: Just drop in the event flyer (PDF or image) and the date and venue are added to Google Calendar automatically. The flyer, roster, results and photos are attached to the event as well. Works for any sport or event.
placeholder.name: Next Dropper coming soon
placeholder.desc: We'll keep adding new drop-to-use tools little by little. Please stay tuned until release.
policy.label: Notes
policy.title: Before you start
policy.desc: We keep prices as low as possible so anyone can give the tools a try. In return, please note the following before you buy.
policy.p1desc: Each tool is priced so you can try it without a second thought. Pick only the ones you need.
policy.p2desc: To keep prices low, we don't offer one-on-one support. Please refer to each tool's guide for how to use it.
policy.p3desc: There's no support, but tools are improved from time to time, and new information is delivered to you automatically from the tool.
about.label: About
about.title: What is Dropper
about.desc: “Just drop in a file, and the hassle is handled.” We call these little tools Dropper, and we build and release them as a series. The first one adds event dates to your calendar. They all work the same way — just drop — so anyone can use them, not only a particular group or sport. More tools will be added over time.
privacy.metaDesc: DROPPER's privacy policy. How your data is handled, how the app accesses Google user data, and what is sent when the AI feature is used.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: DROPPER runs entirely in your browser. We operate no server of our own, and we never collect, store, or transmit your data.
privacy.s2body: DROPPER runs only in your browser. Nothing it reads and no file you drop is ever sent to a server of ours — we do not operate one. All processing happens within your own Google account.
privacy.s3title: 3. How we handle Google user data
privacy.s3body: With your permission, DROPPER accesses Google services within the following scopes.
privacy.s3r1b: To add the event details read from your document to your own calendar.
privacy.s3r2a:
Access to files this app creates
(drive.file)
privacy.s3r2b: To read the text from your document (OCR) and save the document to your own Google Drive.
privacy.s3r3b: To remember which folder your files are saved in, so the same folder is reused across your devices (for example, phone and computer).
privacy.s3n1: All of this data is processed inside your own Google account. We never receive any of it.
privacy.s3n2: drive.file is limited to files this app itself creates. It cannot see the rest of your Google Drive.
privacy.s3n3: Temporary files created for text recognition (OCR) are deleted immediately after the text is read.
privacy.s4notice: When the AI feature is used, the text read from your document is sent to Google's Gemini API. Whether to use this feature is entirely your choice.
privacy.s4n1: Using AI is opt-in. After you sign in, a dialog asks you to choose "Use AI" or "Do not use AI".
privacy.s4n2: Only if you choose "Use AI" is the text read from your document sent to Google's Gemini API.
privacy.s4n3: The request uses an API key that you obtain yourself. The key is stored only on your own device (in your browser's localStorage) and is never sent to us.
privacy.s4n4: Data sent to the Gemini API is handled under Google's own policies.
privacy.s4n5: If you choose "Do not use AI", no text is sent anywhere outside your browser and your own Google account.
privacy.s5title: 5. What is stored on your device
privacy.s5body: The following is stored only on your device (in your browser's localStorage). We cannot read any of it, and you can clear it at any time from your browser settings.
privacy.s5n1: Your choice of whether to use the AI feature
privacy.s5n2: Your Gemini API key (only if you chose to use AI)
privacy.s5n3: Which folder your files are saved in
privacy.s6body: DROPPER is currently provided free of charge, and we do not collect or store any payment information. If paid features are introduced in the future, this policy will be revised and the change announced.
privacy.s7title: 7. Compliance with the Google API Services User Data Policy
privacy.s7body: DROPPER's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
privacy.s8body: Any changes to this policy will be posted on this page. If a change is significant, it will also be announced within the tool.
privacy.s9body: For questions about this policy, please contact movie.pingpong@gmail.com.
tool1.notice: ⚠️ This app is currently under review by Google, so a warning saying "Google hasn't verified this app" appears when you sign in. Choose "Advanced" → "Go to dropper-tools.com (unsafe)" to continue. The warning will disappear once the review is complete.
